I have farmed this small piece of land for many years, and I know that beans grow well here with the rains we get in Kilimanjaro. I will put manure on the soil because I keep some animals and the compost helps the plants, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer since it is too expensive and my beans do not need it. I will plant the seeds I saved from last season and do all the weeding and harvesting with my family. I cannot afford pesticides or to pay workers, so we will manage the plot ourselves without irrigation.
